infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: G2 Companion connects to your G2 glasses over Bluetooth to read status, photo counts and button events.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: G2 Companion uses the glasses' microphone (or the iPhone's) for the voice assistant and translation.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: G2 Companion saves photos and videos imported from your glasses to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: G2 Companion lets you pick a photo for the AI to describe.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: G2 Companion talks to the glasses' own Wi-Fi hotspot to transfer media.
